tasks.natural_request: In scripts/theseus_workspace_hygiene_audit.py, stop treating failure to collect git status as a clean workspace. Add a WorkspaceStatusFault exception. Make git_status_rows raise it with exactly git_status_unavailable for OSError, git_status_timeout for subprocess.TimeoutExpired, and git_status_failed for a nonzero process return; never include stdout or stderr in the exception. Make dirty_workspace_candidates catch that fault and emit exactly one high-priority candidate with kind workspace_status_unavailable and id dirty_workspace_status_unavailable instead of reporting a clean workspace. Preserve normal successful status-row parsing, the audit's non-destructive behavior, and zero external inference. Add focused coverage in tests/test_workspace_hygiene_audit.py.
